name: shalav
description: Technion study tutor inside Claude Desktop: course plans, lessons, exercises and practice with your Claude subscription. No API key.
long_description: Shalav turns Claude into a step-by-step tutor for Technion courses. Add a course by its number, upload lecture notes and past exercises, and learn stage by stage with interactive cards, graded exercises and spaced practice. Your data stays in a folder on your computer.

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where Shalav keeps your courses and progress. Put it inside Google Drive / OneDrive / iCloud to sync between computers.

language.title: Language (he or en)
language.description: Interface and tutoring language on first run: he (Hebrew) or en (English). Changeable later in the Shalav settings card.
